headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: The Hindu / Deccan Chronicle / Munsif Daily
bullets_en: New investments, expansion of units key to TG industrial growth plans: Minister.
25K government jobs will be filled soon, taking total beyond one lakh: Revanth Reddy.
MP: CM Yadav Steps Down as Minister In-Charge of Indore, Raises Eyebrows.
Man sentenced to one year’s imprisonment under POCSO Act.
Mosque committee member helps police find 2 missing girls in Hyderabad.
bullets_ur: Nayi sarmayakariyan aur units ki tausee TG ki sarakhi ki industrial growth ka markazi nuqta hai: Minister.
25K sarkari naukriyan jald pur ki jayengi, kul tadaad ek lakh se tajawuz kar jayegi: Revanth Reddy.
MP: CM Yadav ne Indore ke minister in-charge ke ohday se istefa de diya, herangi paida ho gayi.
POCSO Act ke tehat ek shakhs ko ek saal qaid ki saza suna di gayi.
Hyderabad mein masjid committee ke rukun ne 2 gumshuda larkiion ko dhoondne mein police ki madad ki.
